notes: P1-01 fixed in the main thread only (routes a+b). Root cause: input changes never invalidated the in-flight job — resetResult() cleared outcome/error/selectedSlot but not pendingRef and never bumped jobSeqRef, and the Worker callback only compared jobId/seq, never the input snapshot. Fix (src/ui/App.tsx): new invalidateInFlight() — when a job is actually in flight, sends CANCEL (pending.seq), clears pendingRef, bumps jobSeqRef, clears analyzing/jobId back to READY; resetResult() calls it first, so every input-change path is covered (HTML, Markdown, strategy, preset, onFillCanonical which also changes Markdown). Worker callback adds defense-in-depth: after the seq check it also compares the pending snapshot (html/markdown/strategy) against a live inputsRef mirror and drops mismatches, clearing analyzing so no stuck spinner. Worker file untouched (its generation guard already handles CANCEL/new ANALYZE); InputPanel untouched (no locking, see ISSUE-FIX01-03). Regression tests merged into tests/e2e/tablefork.e2e.ts (no playwright.config.ts change; still functional project): GPT 5-step repro with the preset switch issued synchronously in the same JS task as the compare click (provably before the Worker's macrotask yield — no sleep/poll timing), plus a strategy-switch variant; both assert no old result is shown and none is exportable (no dual table, no witness status, no handoff/JSON pre, Download JSON disabled, empty note visible), then re-analyze normally. Determinism: pre-fix 20/20 FAIL, post-fix 20/20 PASS (10 repeats each). Full acceptance all exit 0: typecheck, test:core 719/719, oracle 48/48, test:e2e 22 passed, test:e2e:perf 1 passed, build. TMPDIR pointed at persistent .tmp-tmpdir (removed afterwards); the two volatile e2e log files dirtied by runs were restored with git checkout. Existing test assertions untouched; no spec/docs/core/worker/version changes. P1-02 untouched (FIX-02).
